canonical_project: NEXTDC SC1 Sunshine Coast Data Centre
notes: 44 Maud St, Maroochydore. Tier III-aligned edge data centre, 1MW IT capacity, 290 sqm technical space, 84 racks. SC1 site hosts the Sunshine Coast (SCIBN/JGA-South and Tabua) subsea cable landing station; Google uses SC1 to support the Tabua cable. Operational per NEXTDC official page (checked 2026-08-12).
